drhp.business: Jet Freight Logistics provides integrated logistics and freight forwarding services comprising international air freight, ocean freight, customs brokerage, transportation, warehousing and allied logistics solutions to customers across pharmaceuticals, engineering, automotive, chemicals, textiles, consumer goods and other manufacturing sectors. The Company operates substantially in a single reportable business segment and combines airline partnerships, charter capabilities and global agency networks with technology-driven operations to deliver end-to-end supply chain solutions worldwide.
drhp.expansion: The Company is expanding freighter cargo capacity through the Airbus A330 P2F passenger-to-freighter conversion programme, developed by Airbus in collaboration with EFW, to convert passenger aircraft into dedicated freighter aircraft capable of transporting significantly higher cargo volumes across medium and long-haul international routes; this is expected to expand its international route network and carrying capacity.
